issue: Caption contains an internal contradiction on the subset/superset relationship between request-latency violations and TTFT violations.
evidence: Caption states 'a subset of TTFT violations' (mid-caption) but later states 'flags a superset of TTFT violations' (end of caption). Since TTFT ≤ request latency, the set of requests with request latency > 2 s is a SUPERSET of TTFT violations (requests with TTFT > 2 s), not a subset. The prose on printed p. 96 correctly says 'flags a superset of TTFT violations.' The two clauses in the same caption assert opposite set relationships for the same set.
acceptance_test: Replace 'a subset of TTFT violations' with 'a superset of TTFT violations' (or rephrase to 'includes all TTFT violations plus requests whose total latency exceeds 2 s despite TTFT ≤ 2 s') so the caption is internally consistent and matches the prose on printed p. 96.
